ingredients.title: For the Meat Topping
items: 1 kg diced onion (finely chopped or processed)

ingredients.title: Ghee & oil mixture
items: 2 tbsp ghee (you can substitute with butter)

method.title: Prepare the Meat Topping
steps: Heat ghee in a large pan over medium heat and cook the minced meat until browned.
Add the diced onions and cook until translucent and most of the water has evaporated.
Remove from heat, season with salt and Lebanese 7 spice.
Stir in tahini paste, pomegranate molasses, and vinegar until well combined.
Add chopped parsley and mint, mix gently, and let the topping cool completely.

method.title: Make the Dough
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, milk powder, sugar, and salt. Add oil and gradually mix in water to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 3-5 minutes until elastic and smooth.
Portion the dough into 45g balls, dip each in oil, and place on an oiled tray. Cover with cling wrap and let it rest for 15-20 min.
In a small boil melt the ghee and top it with oil, set aside.

method.title: Roll and Rest the Dough
steps: Flatten each dough ball with a rolling pin and stack them, brushing with oil and ghee mixture between layers. Cover and let rest for 1 hour.

method.title: Assemble the Lahem B’ajin
steps: Gently stretch the dough from all sides, folding it over itself to form a square shape. Place the shaped pastries onto an oiled aluminum tray.
Once all the pastries are shaped, top each one with the prepared meat mixture then sprinkle with pine nuts.

method.title: Bake
steps: Place the prepared Lahem B’ajin on a baking tray and bake for 8-10 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
